Author: Marulu, StreetRat
Name: MaskedCarnivale
Punchline: Display the game in a separate window.
Description: Renders a separate, overlay-free window mirroring the game so you can stream/record (Discord, Medal, OBS) without Dalamud plugin overlays showing. Opened with /carnivale. Unofficial API-15 port of ProjectMimer's MaskedCarnivale.
